name: Harco
tagline: Most professionals get zero reps before their highest-stakes conversations
description: Most professionals get zero reps before their highest-stakes conversations. The feedback you're dreading. The deal you can't lose. The 1:1 you keep postponing. The first attempt is usually the real thing — when it counts most. Harco is a practice layer for every important conversation. Describe the situation in plain language: who you're talking to, what you want to get right. Harco turns it into a realistic voice simulation you run out loud — with an AI partner that responds, objects, and defle
